theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors sits just behind AI Compute in rank but has the strongest durability_bar (0.58) and a 'trend' hurst tag among eligible tech names, with the best breadth (0.364) in the tech cluster and no crowding. The trend-gate leg has no validated drawdown edge on this market, so this is a durability/cohesion read only, not a gate-backed call.
theses.dissent: Absolute-trend gate failed historically on A-shares and mean-reverting tape whipsaws trend followers; semiconductors may simply be the least-bad of an already fragile leadership stack.
